botsort.name: BoT-SORT no ReID, official demo ORB GMC
botsort.scope: Official demo association defaults and ORB GMC. MFT frame rate25 and common area>100 output filter; person aspect filter not applied. No appearance network or pretrained person-ReID replication.

hybridsort.name: HybridSORT no ReID, official MOT17 ablation association preset
hybridsort.scope: Original Hybrid_Sort API with official preset TCM, low-score association and HMIoU. Other argument defaults come from pinned utils/args.py. No appearance network.
